Regeneration Quirk.name: Regeneration Quirk
Regeneration Quirk.description:
🩹 Your body heals itself fast: cuts close in minutes and a broken bone knits in hours.

🌱 At the start you can also force fresh wounds shut mid-fight and take a blow on purpose to land your own.
📈 With training: blades caught barehanded, poison purged, long falls landed, people pulled from fire, others shielded, marches through anything, a lost limb regrown.
⚠️ You feel every wound, and lost limbs do not grow back yet.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as healing burns your reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Super Regeneration.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Stamina +10, Quirk Control +10, Conditioning +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting techniques: Accepted Blow, Knit Shut
Regeneration Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: fast self-repair. For a new adult user, cuts close in minutes, bruises fade in an hour, broken bones knit in a few hours, all scarless. Faster healing needs techniques. Limits: not instant: a heavy blow still drops the user, pain arrives in full, a fatal wound is still fatal. At the start lost limbs and eyes do not regrow; a blade left in a wound keeps it open; an unset bone knits crooked. Heals only the user. Quirk Strain: none at normal pace; light: taking a blow on purpose; moderate: closing wounds mid-fight, catching a blade, purging a poison, a long fall; heavy: walking through fire, shielding others; severe: signature advance, rebuilding the whole body. Type: Mutant. Law: attackers are still charged for wounds the user healed; unlicensed fighting is still illegal Quirk use. Look: runs warm, eats hugely; wounds close in threads of tissue, bones click into line, skin steams.
